title: Can You Keep Your Number After Canceling an AI Receptionist?
meta_description: Read on 1 October 2026: free Vapi numbers cannot be ported out, a released Twilio number can be reclaimed for 10 days, and a closed Twilio account's data is deleted in 30 days.
secondary_keywords: can i keep my phone number if i cancel my ai receptionist
can you port a free vapi number
ai receptionist call recordings after cancellation
switch ai receptionist provider keep number

image.takeaway: Port the number before you cancel. Twilio lets you reclaim a released number for 10 days.
image.alt: Can you keep your number after canceling an AI receptionist? Port it before you cancel, because a released Twilio number can be reclaimed for 10 days
